# Third-party sources: sky, time of day and navigation (M1 wave 2)

This track owns `src/Lifestone.Game/scripts/World/Sky/`, `scripts/UI/`, `scripts/Diagnostics/GoldenViewpointsRunner.cs`, `src/Lifestone.Client/{Sky,Navigation}/`, `src/Lifestone.Data/World/Data/` and `tools/data/extract_ace_poi.py`. It builds on the wave-1 sky data layer ([sky.md](sky.md) in this folder lists that layer's sources).

No third-party code was copied or ported. Retail behaviour was re-expressed from the decompile and is cited by function name in the code. The one third-party **data** file is the AGPL-3.0 extract described below.

## Retail functions re-expressed (11.4186 `acclient.c` line numbers)

- **`PORTAL/lscape/Sky.c`**
  - `GameSky::UpdatePosition` (308367)
  - `GameSky::MakeObject` (308427)
  - `GameSky::CalcFrame` (308459)
  - `GameSky::Draw` (308475)
  - `GameSky::OnTimeAdjustment` (308535)
  - `GameSky::CreateDeletePhysicsObjects` (308687)
  - `GameSky::UseTime` (308826)
- **`PORTAL/lscape/LScape.c`**
  - `LScape::SetDay` (306897)
  - `LScape::set_sky_position` (306447)
  - `LScape::UseTime` (307221)
  - `LScape::draw` (307754)
  - `LScape::weather_enabled` = true (45179)
- **`SmartBox::set_viewer` (143995):** the viewer position that the sky follows.
- **`SceneTool::BeginScene` (122402):** the frame is cleared to black.
- **Render state and placement:**
  - `Render::zfar` = 4000 (45527) and `Render::znear` = 0.1 (45526);
  - `Render::update_viewpoint` (380352);
  - `PrimD3DRender::positionPushInternal` (453522);
  - `PrimD3DRender::CalcObjectMatrixInternal` (453636);
  - `Frame::interpolate_origin` (357229).
- **Surfaces and materials:**
  - `D3DPolyRender::SetSurface` (454385; the part-material test at 454531);
  - `D3DPolyRender::RenderMeshSubset` (454633);
  - `D3DPolyRender::DrawMesh` (455154);
  - `copyVert` (454109);
  - `RenderDeviceD3D::SetCurrentMaterial` (457648).
- **Part lighting state:**
  - `CPhysicsObj::SetTranslucency` (318694), `CPhysicsObj::SetLuminosity` (318827), `CPhysicsObj::SetDiffusion` (318895);
  - `CPartArray::SetTranslucencyInternal`, `SetLuminosityInternal` and `SetDiffusionInternal` (325638-325750);
  - `CPhysicsPart::CopyMaterial` (314472), `CurSettingsAreDefault` (314711), `SetDiffusion` (315420), `SetLuminosity` (315454), `SetTranslucency` (315488);
  - `CMaterial::CheckAlphaValues`, `SetTranslucencySimple`, `SetLuminositySimple`, `SetDiffuseSimple` and the constructor (360585-360653);
  - `CGfxObj::CGfxObj` (356358): the GfxObj's own material is always null.
- **`CPlayerSystem::InqPlayerCoords` (398264):** the map coordinates that the parser inverts (as the core's `AcCoordinates` cites).
- **`GameTime::UseTime` (463394):** game time = server clock + `TimeZeroDelta` (the wave-1 calendar).

## Wave-3 navigation fixes

- **`LandDefs::gid_to_lcoord` (209521):** refuses cell indices of 0x100 and above, so `CPlayerSystem::InqPlayerCoords` (398264) and the radar show no coordinates in EnvCells; the position HUD follows it (`PositionReadout`).
- **ACE `WorldObject.AdjustDungeon`** (Source/ACE.Server/WorldObjects/WorldObject.cs:738, @95ef426d): read to explain why some ACE drop points name a cell that does not hold the point; Lifestone keeps the raw Destination and lets the cell tracker find the cell (docs/navigation.md §1). Nothing ported.
- **The curated interiors** in the panel are the interiors track's `InteriorLocations` (ACViewer `Data/Locations.txt` @c5c54fb, GPL-3.0, and ACE's starting position; listed in [interiors.md](interiors.md)). No new data.
- **The legal notices** (`LegalNotices`) use the licence grant and no-warranty wording the FSF recommends in the AGPL's "How to Apply These Terms" appendix (part of the licence text in LICENSE).

## Not used

- **OpenAC** (MIT, @1ee5a08) was read for one comparison only, and no code was used. Its `src/AcDream.App/Rendering/Sky/SkyRenderer.cs` (lines 79-82) zeroes the view translation, so its sky is centred on the camera; the decompile does not do that (docs/sky.md §4.2).
- The earlier prototype's sky is an approximation (docs/research/rendering.md) and was not used.
